packs.title: General knowledge (Wikidata)
packs.detail: A Wikidata core: 303,149 entities, 3.46M facts + 1.04M dates and quantities, 1,089 relations. Loads ~3 MB, then fetches the facts each question needs.
packs.placeholder: e.g. Who was Abraham Lincoln's first child?
packs.preview: gets about 1 in 5 open questions right (Mintaka dev: 21.1%, 421 of all 2,000 questions, with this pack, 22.8% on the full 4.8M-entity graph). Check the path it shows. ~23M parameters total (a 0.1M-parameter trained scorer on a frozen 22.7M MiniLM).
